JLPT · N4, the second level

JLPT N4 vocabulary list
all 655 words

N4 covers basic Japanese read and heard at a natural pace on familiar topics. This list holds the 655 words that are new at N4, on top of the N5 set. Every entry shows the word, its kana reading and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Japanese this list is the N4 pack: a word waits in kanji, the way the test shows it; one tap reveals the reading, the meaning and a real sentence. JLPT N4 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Japanese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

盗む

ぬすむ

to steal

泥棒が財布を盗みました。

どろぼうがさいふをぬすみました。

The thief stole my wallet.

絹

きぬ

silk fabric

そのスカーフは絹でできています。

このスカーフはきぬでできています。

This scarf is made of silk.

悲しい

かなしい

sad

友達との別れはとても悲しいです。

ともだちとのわかれはとてもかなしいです。

It is very sad to part from a friend.

故障

こしょうする

mechanical breakdown (to break down)

コピー機が故障しました。

こぴーきがこしょうしました。

The photocopier broke down.

力

ちから

strength, power, ability

彼は力がある人です。

かれはちからがあるひとです。

He is a capable person.

親切

しんせつ

kindness

隣の人はとても親切です。

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the JLPT N4 vocabulary list?

655. The JLPT publishes no official vocabulary counts. The widely used lists this page follows put N5 at about 700 words and all five levels at about 8,000 words together; this page lists the words that are new at JLPT N4.

Is this the official JLPT N4 word list?

There is no official list: the JLPT stopped publishing vocabulary lists with the 2010 revision. This page follows the widely used community lists (after Jonathan Waller's tanos.co.uk lists), which is what most textbooks and apps mean by an JLPT N4 list.

How do I study the JLPT N4 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Japanese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Japanese. The N4 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. JLPT N4 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the JLPT N4 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Japanese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: JLPT N5 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
